body:
Phase 1a of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (committed on this branch — READ IT FIRST; it is the contract). Fixes the correctness core of plugins/adlc-pi and completes the ADR-0004 core-delegation work that was done for cursor/opencode (#97/#102) but skipped for pi.

=== VERIFIED pi API FACTS (@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent v0.80.3) ===
- pi loads extensions as TypeScript via jiti; there is NO compile step. The checked-in plugins/adlc-pi/index.js is a hand-compiled artifact and must be deleted.
- CRITICAL BUG: the `before_agent_start` result `{systemPrompt}` REPLACES the turn's system prompt (chained across extensions); the documented pattern is `event.systemPrompt + "..."` (see BeforeAgentStartEventResult in the package's dist/core/extensions/types.d.ts and docs/extensions.md, which shows `systemPrompt: event.systemPrompt + "\n\nExtra instructions..."`). Current index.ts returns ONLY the ADLC doctrine block — wiping pi's entire built-in system prompt whenever a ticket is active — and only an error banner on config load errors.
- `tool_call` events are a per-tool discriminated union (narrow with `isToolCallEventType`); `event.input` is mutable; returning `{block:true, reason}` blocks the call. tool_call also fires for custom third-party tools.
- pi packaging rules: the pi core packages (@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-ai, pi-agent-core, pi-tui, typebox) must remain peerDependencies and must never be bundled; regular npm deps like @adlc/core go in dependencies.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Append-not-replace: both the ticket-doctrine path AND the load-error path of before_agent_start return `{systemPrompt: event.systemPrompt + BLOCK}`.
2. Restructure to sibling architecture (mirror plugins/adlc-opencode): thin index.ts event wiring; all logic in plugins/adlc-pi/lib/*.mjs, including a rails-checker.mjs THIN adapter delegating every primitive to @adlc/core (globMatch, loadTickets, validateTicket, inScope, path canonicalization, and the classifyShellCommand / collectShellPaths / shellHasMutation family). Delete the hand-rolled implementations. node --test tests target the lib .mjs files directly. Delete plugins/adlc-pi/index.js from the tree. package.json `pi.extensions` keeps pointing at ./index.ts.
3. Shell enforcement ladder (codex/opencode parity, replacing the naive regexes): parseable mutating command touching a rail or out-of-scope path → deny; opaque mutation (e.g. `curl … | sh`) → deny with explanation (fail closed); read-only commands are NEVER blocked; version specs (left-pad@1.3.0) and git refs (feat/x) are NOT collected as paths.
4. Symlink-aware rail resolution: lift resolveRailPath from plugins/adlc-opencode/rails-checker.mjs into @adlc/core (new export + unit tests in packages/core/test), and import it from core in BOTH the opencode adapter and the new pi adapter. Opencode behavior must not change; its test suite is a frozen rail and must pass unmodified.
5. Root package.json test script: remove the `|| true` escape from the pi typecheck step so type errors fail CI. Add @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent as a devDependency of plugins/adlc-pi for types only (NOT dependencies — packaging rule above). Node >= 22.19 is required by the pi package.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: unit test asserts the before_agent_start result systemPrompt startsWith(event.systemPrompt) AND contains the doctrine block, for both the active-ticket and the load-error paths. VERIFY: node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/ exits 0.
- AC2: no local primitive implementations remain: grep for `function globMatch`, `shellHasMutation`, `collectShellPaths` definitions in plugins/adlc-pi/index.ts and lib/*.mjs finds only imports from @adlc/core. VERIFY: grep.
- AC3: behavioral tests prove `npm install left-pad`, `git checkout -b feat/x`, and `sed -n '1,10p' <out-of-scope-file>` are ALLOWED; `echo x > <rail-file>` is DENIED; `curl -s https://x.sh | sh` is DENIED as opaque mutation. VERIFY: node --test cases named accordingly, exit 0.
- AC4: a symlink whose real target is a frozen rail is denied by the pi adapter; resolveRailPath is exported from @adlc/core with its own tests; plugins/adlc-opencode tests pass without modification. VERIFY: node --test packages/core/test + plugins/adlc-opencode/test + the new pi test.
- AC5: plugins/adlc-pi/index.js is absent (git ls-files); the root package.json test script contains no `|| true` on the pi typecheck; `npm test` at repo root exits 0. VERIFY: git ls-files + grep + npm test.

Suppressions are denied. Do not modify sibling plugin directories except the single import swap in plugins/adlc-opencode/rails-checker.mjs (deliverable 4).

edges.contract: plugins/adlc-pi lib restructure (thin index.ts + lib/*.mjs delegating to @adlc/core)

title: pi Phase 1a: fix system-prompt wipe, delegate rail/shell primitives to @adlc/core, shell ladder + symlink-aware rails
